summary: Sacks argues that NVIDIA GPUs are artificially expensive due to supply scarcity and that chip prices will inevitably come down as production scales, compressing margins and normalizing infrastructure costs.
quote: part of the reason for that is the scarcity. They haven't been able to produce as much as there's demand for. And so they're commanding a premium right now... over time the price of these chips just has to come down.
